grades.reason: Describes the STLBPS CSR page size field. It says nothing about the constant-zero general register r0 or about writes to it. The 'R0' attribute here is a CSR field attribute, not register r0.
Describes the MISC CSR control bits. It does not cover the effect of writing to general register r0. Its 'R0' entries are CSR field attributes.

Defines the read/write attributes of CSR fields, including the 'R0' attribute. This refers to CSR fields that always read 0, not the constant-zero general register r0. It does not say what happens when an instruction writes to r0.
Describes the ESTAT exception status CSR fields. It does not address writes to general register r0.
